zh: 平台全局审计日志升级：支持 iOS/Android/桌面端/Web 端多维分类筛选、真实客户端 IP 解析、设备型号识别与服务端自动分页。
左侧会话侧边栏全面升级：支持所有类型会话（普通任务、空间对话、三方桌面 Agent 及外部渠道）统一置顶，并自动在顶部置顶分组集中展示。
增强移动设备与智能体生态：集成 Open-AutoGLM Android 自动化控制技能，完善移动端 App 请求特征精准识别。
en: Upgrade platform audit logs with multi-platform filtering (iOS, Android, Desktop, Web), proxy-aware client IP extraction, device detection, and pagination.
Introduce universal pinned conversations across sidebar sections for standard chats, space projects, desktop agents, and external channel threads.
Expand agent mobile automation with the Open-AutoGLM Android control skill and improved mobile application client identification.
